about.headline: About Efosa Ojomo Technology Services
bio: I'm Efosa Ojomo, a technology professional, software engineer, and technical product leader with experience across enterprise software, cloud platforms, product development, and AI-driven solutions.

Throughout my career, I've worked across complex technology environments, including Microsoft-related enterprise platforms, helping bridge the gap between business objectives, customer needs, and technical execution.
My background spans software architecture, enterprise SaaS, cloud technologies, AI integration, systems engineering, and technical product management.

I founded Efosa Ojomo Technology Services to bring practical technology expertise and structured product delivery to businesses that need reliable solutions without the complexity of managing large technical teams.

Whether you're a small-business owner who needs a professional digital presence, a founder bringing a new product to market, or an established organization improving its technology operations, my goal is the same: understand your business, identify what matters, and deliver solutions that create lasting value.
I believe the best technology partnerships are built on clarity, accountability, honest advice, and measurable outcomes.

pedigree.title: We Start With Your Problem, Not a Technology Pitch.
pedigree.desc: Before recommending any solution, we take time to understand what you're trying to accomplish. Sometimes that means building something new. Other times, it means improving what you already have.

pedigree.title: Technical Expertise Meets Business Understanding.
pedigree.desc: We combine engineering knowledge with product and business thinking. Our recommendations consider usability, costs, implementation effort, security, and long-term value.

pedigree.title: Solutions Built Around Your Needs.
pedigree.desc: Your business is unique. We don't believe every problem requires expensive software, complex architecture, or the latest AI tool. We recommend solutions that fit your goals and resources.

pedigree.title: Clear Communication. No Unnecessary Complexity.
pedigree.desc: You deserve to understand what you're paying for, what's being built, when to expect delivery, and how success will be evaluated.

pedigree.title: A Partner Beyond the Launch.
pedigree.desc: Technology doesn't stop evolving after deployment. Where ongoing services are needed, we can help maintain, improve, and adapt your solutions as your business grows.

cta.title: Let's Build Something That Works for Your Business.
cta.description:
You don't have to figure out every technical detail on your own.

Whether you're launching a business, improving operations, exploring AI, building custom software, or bringing a digital product to life, we're here to help you make informed decisions and move from ideas to execution.

You bring the vision and business knowledge. We bring the technical expertise, structured approach, and commitment to delivering practical solutions.

Let's discuss what you're trying to achieve.

about.tagline: Your Vision. Our Expertise. Technology That Works for You.
about.introductionHeading: We Help Businesses Turn Challenges Into Opportunities.
introduction: Every business has an idea worth exploring, a process worth improving, or a problem technology could solve.

But turning those opportunities into results isn't always easy. You may need a professional website, software tailored to your operations, a way to automate repetitive tasks, or experienced technical leadership to bring a product idea to life.

At Efosa Ojomo Technology Services, we help small businesses, startups, and growing organizations plan, build, improve, and manage technology that makes their work easier and their businesses stronger.
From your first idea to implementation and ongoing support, we bring together software engineering, product management, AI solutions, and technology advisory to help you move forward with confidence.
about.promise: You focus on running your business. We help make your technology work for it.
about.founderRole: Technology & Product Consultant | Software Engineering | AI Solutions | Technical Product Leadership
about.founderPrinciple: Technology should solve real problems, not create more of them.

cards.title: Small Businesses — Run Smarter. Grow Stronger.
body: You shouldn't need an entire IT department to benefit from modern technology.
We help small businesses establish their online presence, improve customer experiences, automate time-consuming tasks, and implement software that supports everyday operations.
Whether you need your first website, an improved booking process, customer support tools, or help managing existing technology, we provide practical solutions designed around your needs and budget.

cards.title: Startups & Entrepreneurs — From Idea to Execution.
body: Have an idea but need help turning it into a real product?
We work with founders to clarify their vision, validate requirements, define a product roadmap, build minimum viable products (MVPs), and guide development from concept through launch.
Our approach combines product thinking with engineering execution so you can prioritize the right features, reduce unnecessary development costs, and build with a clear purpose.

cards.title: Growing Companies & Enterprises — Expertise When You Need It.
body: As businesses grow, their technology needs become more complex.

We provide software architecture, technical product management, AI integration, systems modernization, and strategic technology advisory to help organizations improve delivery, streamline operations, and scale their systems.
Whether you need project-based expertise or ongoing technical leadership, we help bridge the gap between strategy and execution.

foundation.heading: Built on Engineering Knowledge. Guided by Product Thinking.
paragraphs: Our founder's background brings together formal engineering education and practical enterprise technology experience.

With advanced education in Computer Technology and Computer Electronics Systems Engineering, alongside a foundation in Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Efosa combines systems-level technical understanding with modern software and product development practices.

Professional credentials include Professional Scrum Master (PSM I) and Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO I), reflecting a structured approach to agile delivery, product ownership, and continuous improvement.
This combination of technical and product expertise informs how we approach every engagement: understand the problem, evaluate the trade-offs, build responsibly, and focus on outcomes.

engagements.priceNotice: Paid services are scoped and quoted after discovery. Any published starting fees are in USD; the written proposal confirms the final fee.
engagements.scopeTitle: How project delivery and ongoing care work
scopeItems: Project fees depend on the agreed scope, complexity, responsibilities, and review points. Third-party subscriptions and usage costs are identified separately.
All paid engagements require an approved written agreement or Statement of Work before work begins.
Monthly plans cover named systems and agreed tasks, capacity, service hours, response expectations, exclusions, and usage limits. Maintenance does not include unlimited development.
New features, additional workflows, emergency work, and support outside the agreement are separately scoped.
Customer support services cover support technology and workflows. Human support-agent staffing and round-the-clock customer-service coverage are excluded.

privacy.label: Legal draft — review required
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introduction: This draft explains how Efosa Ojomo Technology & Product Consulting may collect and use information submitted through this website. It must be reviewed and approved for the applicable business, jurisdiction, vendors, and data-retention practices before publication.

sections.title: Information you submit
sections.body: When you submit an inquiry or request a consultation, the site may collect your name, business email, company, website, requested service, project details, timeline, budget range, and consent record.

sections.title: How information may be used
sections.body: Information may be used to respond to inquiries, evaluate a potential engagement, schedule calls, provide requested services, maintain security, and measure website conversions where consent and applicable law permit.

sections.title: Service providers
sections.body: Production integrations may include a hosting provider, scheduling provider, email provider, database, and analytics provider. Their use must be configured and documented before launch.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Update this section with the approved business contact address and privacy-request process before publishing.

terms.label: Legal draft — review required
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.introduction: This draft describes the general terms for using this website and exploring consulting services. It is not final legal advice and must be reviewed by qualified counsel before production publication.

sections.title: Consulting engagements
sections.body: Specific scope, deliverables, fees, timelines, assumptions, confidentiality, intellectual property, and termination terms should be defined in a written proposal or agreement accepted by both parties.

sections.title: Advisory scope
sections.body: Unless a signed agreement says otherwise, content on this site is general information and does not guarantee a particular technical, financial, operational, or business outcome.

sections.title: Payments and scheduling
sections.body: Any paid workshop or fixed-price service must be governed by the approved proposal, invoice, and consulting agreement. Custom work and retainers should not be charged automatically without approval.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Update this section with the approved business contact address and governing-law language before publishing.
